headline_events.title: Zyxel fixes zero-day exploited to hack nearly 1,000 network switches
headline_events.title_zh: Zyxel 修復已遭利用入侵近 1,000 台網路交換器的零日漏洞
headline_events.summary: Zyxel has patched a zero-day vulnerability in its GS1900 series network switches that hackers exploited to compromise nearly 1,000 devices worldwide and steal configuration files and credentials. [...]
headline_events.summary_zh: Zyxel 已修補其 GS1900 系列網路交換器中的一個零日漏洞，駭客利用該漏洞入侵了全球近 1,000 台設備，並竊取設定檔與憑證。[...]

headline_events.title: CISA flags WordPress RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks
headline_events.title_zh: CISA 將 WordPress RCE 漏洞標記為已在攻擊中被積極利用
headline_events.summary: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers have started exploiting a recently patched high-severity WordPress vulnerability in the wild. [...]
headline_events.summary_zh: 美國網路安全暨基礎設施安全局（CISA）警告聯邦機構，攻擊者已開始在野外利用最近修補的高風險 WordPress 漏洞。[...]

headline_events.title: NIKKE PC game launcher hacked to spread remote access, data-stealing malware
headline_events.title_zh: NIKKE PC 版遊戲啟動器遭駭以散播遠端存取與資料竊取惡意軟體
headline_events.summary: The developers of Goddess of Victory: NIKKE have confirmed that hackers tampered with the game's PC launcher scripts in a supply-chain attack, distributing malware capable of stealing credentials and cryptocurrency wallet data. [...]
headline_events.summary_zh: 《勝利女神：妮姬》的開發商已確認，駭客在一場供應鏈攻擊中篡改了該遊戲的 PC 版啟動器腳本，散播能夠竊取憑證和加密貨幣錢包資料的惡意軟體。[...]

headline_events.title: Malicious cPGuard Updates Served in OpsShield Supply Chain Attack
headline_events.title_zh: OpsShield 供應鏈攻擊中派發惡意 cPGuard 更新
headline_events.summary: Using compromised credentials, the attackers accessed OpsShield’s update servers and poisoned multiple cPGuard versions. The post Malicious cPGuard Updates Served in OpsShield Supply Chain Attack appeared first on SecurityWeek .
headline_events.summary_zh: 攻擊者利用遭入侵的憑證存取了 OpsShield 的更新伺服器，並投毒了多個 cPGuard 版本。該文章《Malicious cPGuard Updates Served in OpsShield Supply Chain Attack》首次出現在 SecurityWeek。

headline_events.title: DreamHost confirms data breach exposed FTP logins and webmail sessions
headline_events.title_zh: DreamHost 確認資料外洩事件暴露 FTP 登入資訊與 Webmail 工作階段
headline_events.summary: DreamHost is warning of a data breach after attackers gained access to its File Manager platform for two months and stole customers' FTP/SFTP usernames and passwords. [...]
headline_events.summary_zh: DreamHost 正就一起資料外洩事件發出警告，攻擊者存取其 File Manager 平台長達兩個月，並竊取了客戶的 FTP/SFTP 使用者名稱與密碼。[...]

headline_events.title: AI-Linked Breaches Mount as WorkOS, Northflank, Trigger.dev Disclose Hacks
headline_events.title_zh: 與 AI 相關的資料洩漏事件增加：WorkOS、Northflank 與 Trigger.dev 揭露遭駭客入侵
headline_events.summary: Hackers have been harvesting AI access tokens and have been using AI-assisted offensive tools to automate attacks. The post AI-Linked Breaches Mount as WorkOS, Northflank, Trigger.dev Disclose Hacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .
headline_events.summary_zh: 駭客一直在收集 AI 存取權杖（tokens），並使用 AI 輔助的攻擊工具來自動化攻擊。這篇「AI-Linked Breaches Mount as WorkOS, Northflank, Trigger.dev Disclose Hacks」文章首先發表於 SecurityWeek。

facts.title: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
facts.title_zh: Apple 多款產品身分驗證不當漏洞
facts.description: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.
facts.description_zh: Apple iOS、iPadOS、macOS、Safari、tvOS 和 watchOS 10.5 包含身分驗證不當漏洞，可能允許具備任意讀寫能力的攻擊者繞過指標身分驗證（Pointer Authentication）。

facts.title: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
facts.description: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

cisa_kev.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
cisa_kev.notes: Other products can potentially be affected by the same underlying Ruby/Onigmo Integer Overflow issue in CI/CD Regular Expression Compiler. For more information please see: https://www.ruby-lang.org/en/news/2026/10/23/regexp-fixes-for-gitlab-cves ; https://docs.gitlab.com/releases/patches/patch-release-gitlab-19-4-2-released/ ; BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-97229

facts.description: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 has a use-after-free in the client's rdpgfx dynamic virtual channel: a duplicate-name channel with a new ChannelId overwrites the listener's single callback slot, which rdpgfx_on_close frees without clearing. A malicious RDP server can open and close such a channel, then send a PDU on the original channel to crash the client or potentially execute code.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 has an out-of-bounds write in the proxy because rdp_read_bitmap_cache_v2_capability_set rejects only numCellCaches values above 5, yet the bitmap cache v2 cell array is later accessed at fixed indices 0 through 4. A client connecting to the proxy can declare fewer than five cell caches in its Confirm Active, causing heap corruption, heap data leakage to the backend, or a crash.

Databasement before 1.10.9 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in OAuthService::findOrCreateLocalUser() that links OIDC identities to local users by email without checking email_verified. Attackers can register an identity provider account with a victim's unverified email to log in as any user, including the super-admin, and retain access after password resets.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in the RD Gateway RPC client, where rpc_client_recv_fragment writes BIND_ACK and ALTER_CONTEXT_RESP fragments into a persistent PDU stream after checking only total capacity rather than remaining capacity from the current stream position. A malicious or compromised RD Gateway can send crafted RPC fragments with manipulated alloc_hint and frag_length values to overwrite client heap memory with attacker-controlled data, causing a crash or potentially arbitrary code execution.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the asynchronous dynamic rdpsnd channel that allows malicious RDP servers to trigger freed callback access by closing the channel with queued audio PDUs. Attackers can send a training PDU then close the channel so the playback thread reads the freed callback in rdpsnd_virtual_channel_write, crashing the client.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 contains a heap buffer overflow in transport_default_read_pdu when handling partial Early User Authorization reads during PROTOCOL_HYBRID_EX CredSSP. A malicious RDP server can split the four-byte EUA result into short reads that advance the stream pointer beyond the 16 KiB allocation, causing an out-of-bounds write and client denial of service.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the freerdp-proxy DRDYNVC tracker when intercepting the drdynvc channel. A malicious target server can repeatedly send CREATE_REQUEST_PDU for an active channel id, racing front DATA handling to free a borrowed context and crash the proxy process.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the NLA-enabled shadow server when a CredSSP TSRequest omits negoTokens. Unauthenticated attackers can send a crafted seven-byte TSRequest containing only the version field to trigger a fatal WINPR_ASSERT and abort the server process.

priority_cves.description: Databasement before 1.10.9 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in OAuthService::findOrCreateLocalUser() that links OIDC identities to local users by email without checking email_verified. Attackers can register an identity provider account with a victim's unverified email to log in as any user, including the super-admin, and retain access after password resets.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 has an out-of-bounds write in the proxy because rdp_read_bitmap_cache_v2_capability_set rejects only numCellCaches values above 5, yet the bitmap cache v2 cell array is later accessed at fixed indices 0 through 4. A client connecting to the proxy can declare fewer than five cell caches in its Confirm Active, causing heap corruption, heap data leakage to the backend, or a crash.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 has a use-after-free in the client's rdpgfx dynamic virtual channel: a duplicate-name channel with a new ChannelId overwrites the listener's single callback slot, which rdpgfx_on_close frees without clearing. A malicious RDP server can open and close such a channel, then send a PDU on the original channel to crash the client or potentially execute code.

Stonewuu ai-fusion-video before 1.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access other users' projects by supplying unscoped object ids. Attackers can enumerate auto-increment ids on /api/project, /api/asset and /api/script handlers to read, overwrite, cascade-delete data, and add themselves as project members.

libmt32emu before 2.8.4 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in MidiStreamParserImpl::parseSysex that allows attackers to write past a heap allocation by supplying oversized unterminated SysEx messages. Attackers can feed more than 32768 SysEx data bytes through the mt32emu_parse_stream API via MIDI files, ports, or sequencer clients to corrupt heap memory and crash the application.

CoopCycle coopcycle-web before 6.20.1 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows any courier to read and modify every incident because Incident operations only check ROLE_COURIER. Attackers can enumerate sequential incident ids and use PUT /api/incidents/{id}/action to re-price, cancel or reschedule other stores' orders and tasks.

FreeRDP before 3.32.2 does not check the product of surface dimensions in gdi_CreateSurface when handling an RDPGFX CREATE_SURFACE PDU, causing an integer wrap and heap buffer overflow on 32-bit builds and an approximately 4 GiB allocation on 64-bit builds. A malicious RDP server can send a CREATE_SURFACE PDU with width and height 32766 to a connecting client to corrupt heap memory or cause a denial of service.

FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.2 server-side RDP peer input parsing skips the six-byte body of a slow-path input event with an unknown message type without checking it lies within the packet's declared length, causing a WinPR stream assertion failure. A remote RDP client with an active session can send a truncated unknown input event to abort assertion-enabled server processes, causing denial of service.

trust_boundary.facts: CISA KEV, NVD, FIRST EPSS, vendor/security news feeds and deterministic collectors provide facts.
trust_boundary.intelligence: LLM may translate, summarize and analyze only collected source text and verified facts; it must not invent CVE, CVSS, EPSS, KEV, exploitation status, dates or affected versions.
trust_boundary.unknown_policy: Missing or unsupported facts remain unconfirmed rather than inferred.
